notes.title: THE RELEASE IS NOW OLD MAN!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we're very excited to present to you Bodacious Agent's full release! One of us has moved house since our last update in August, but we've worked hard in that time and we're confident in showing you the results of our efforts. Without further adieu - in this release update:
[list]
[*] A full superspy experience across 6 levels (including a boat race and a trip to the moon!)
[*] A complete cast of villains (with full pulp!)
[*] A variety of gadgets to assist you
[*] Disguises! (So many disguises! See if you can find them all!)
[*] Two additional agents (and Lerry) for you to unlock (other than Agent Gertz), with a unique set of disguises for every character
[*] Full soundtrack
[*] One or two secret things for the keen eyed
[/list]

Thank you to those who have supported us and followed us on this journey. To those who tried our demo, thank you as well, and we encourage you to (please) try it again! We've streamlined and improved various systems and features we introduced in previous updates and learned much as a result. 

If you liked this project and want to be updated on our future works, there is a patreon you can follow [url=https://www.patreon.com/PirateDaveProductions]here[/url].

We hope you enjoy, thanks all!
Aristophanes Yates and Pirate Dave

notes.title: checkpoints!
notes.content:
The main thing we focused on in this update is a bit of a rework to the checkpoints. Now when you load a level that you have already played, you will get a pop up that asks if you want to load the last checkpoint you found. Unfortunately because we had to rework the underlying system, this will only work if the checkpoint was gotten AFTER the update.

In this update
-Made new materials 
-Added outfit icons 
-Added a menu to load last checkpoint on replay
-Added a better indicator for when you take damage
    -An "ouch" sound effect
    -A red border that flashes on damage
    -A jump effect
-some general bug fixing

notes.title: bug fixes, and small update
notes.content:
in this update
-bug fixes
-moved some outfits around
-added new outfits
-added a text pop up were players were getting lost
-changed the particle effect on the jump pad to make it more clear
there will be an update to the demo coming soon

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/e4711b9fece3a8dcb40ac2c605618022add72db2.png[/img]

notes.title: the state of early access
notes.content:
[u][b]the state of progress[/b][/u]
We are working on an update to patch some of the bugs that were reported to us as soon as we can. We hope to have it out in a week or so.
We have been working on Bodacious Agents for nearly two and a half years. It has been such a large part of my life and it saddens me that the progress has been so slow. but as we are a small team of two, we have to maintain day jobs as well as making this game. 

    [u][b]Price drop[/b][/u]
After some feedback, we have come to the realization that the price is somewhat high. And have made the decision to drop it to better reflect the game we are able to bring you. This should be updated by the time you are seeing this post.

thank you for taking the time to read this,
Pirate Dave

notes.title: Early Access Imminent!
notes.content:
We're pleased to inform you Early Access will launch this month! 

Everything is looking good, we are mostly waiting on preliminary processing. We've been keeping most of the stuff we've been working on under-hat, so expect some never-before-seen levels, new outfits, new tweaks, new features and polish, and more! More details once Early Access launches, so stay tuned!

Aristophanes Yates and Pirate Dave.

notes.title: Quick Xmass Update
notes.content:
Just a few stocking stuffers while we were reorganizing our workflow and preparing for that Early Access release. Christmas came a little late at B.O.D.A.C.I.O.U.S. HQ, but we hope those few of you who played this December enjoyed the second coming of Halloween! Future Decembers should be a tad more jingle jangle, and for what remains of this one.

In this update:
- Christmas outfits and decorations at HQ (the Training level)
- Fixed Halloween decorations subsuming all holidays (back to October, where you belong!)
- A lot of groundwork and bug fixes mostly pertaining to future content (gadgets, outfits, new levels)
- Reworked some of the girls' textures
- Streamer mode (Censor mosaic)

Happy New Year's Eve! 

P.S.
We apologise to our players closer to the Eastern Hemisphere for the delay, and wish them a happy New Year!

notes.title: SPOOKY time!
notes.content:
It's Halloween at B.O.D.A.C.I.O.U.S. Head quarters, and in this quick update we added some new outfits, and the training level is decorated. We also fixed a few small things from the last update. 

Have a Spookful October everyone!

notes.title: big update to the demo!
notes.content:
Our newest super secret agent, Sarah! An operative capable of great leaps and bounds!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/c58a088e3fe3594409988ac47416b27e1b6ff047.png[/img]

Equipped with her background as a world-class athlete, she is a truly towering figure at B.O.D.A.C.I.O.U.S.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/b17e7df46056720290cd257bbb5877ee055dbe39.png[/img]

A tutorial plus two full feature levels (includes new level, The Mall!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/b4121a5322605b1105b0d7df1b0119848f01a49e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/46aca33026db8a2ac8a51bf2d2f44534e74c7f49.png[/img]

Improved combat - Enemies
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/c0b9f91fed29fd27766c956ac24665e8aaa3643c.png[/img]

Three all new saucy outfits for you to find! Here’s a sneak peak!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/d0ab5a51cf2988c4634de84ca7704f0c4030c188.png[/img]

Story? You got it! We made a whole system for cut scenes. It's got sprites, words and buttons!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/61765dedef04cd19ee82de262263f9032797fae4.png[/img]

And the little things here and there that once vexed us. Like this little ledge-grab animation that now works for all available characters and outfits!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/1787c3f22adbb81562f16f52114c546ff19531b1.png[/img]

That’s all for now, we’ll have another smaller update this October. We hope you enjoy Sarah and the new level. Please don’t hesitate to contact us to tell us what you think (or just to say hi)! You can contact us via: 
our subreddit (https://www.reddit.com/r/BodaciousAgents/comments/16yghhq/stick_your_feedback_here/), 
our email (bodaciousfans@gmx.com), 
or by replying to this very community post! 
Signed, Pirate Dave and Aristophanes Yates

notes.title: New Content Coming!
notes.content:
We’re very pleased to announce that Bodacious Agents will be getting a significant update very very soon! Introducing Sarah, a world-class athlete turned superspy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/9970df923e258c11e4737ce908757f6b1093e30e.png[/img]

We’re also super excited to be getting into the actual progression of the story and linking everything in a more finalised manner - Agent Gerts is on a mission to reclaim her friends from the clutches of evil. So evil in fact, they destroyed a mall! And so to find Saraah, she must delve deep into what was once her refuge, forever changed into a den of dilapidation and villainy! Introducing our second full level - The Mall!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/46aca33026db8a2ac8a51bf2d2f44534e74c7f49.png[/img]

Many bugs have been fixed and progress is picking up. Now more than ever, we’re excited to hear your thoughts and suggestions, and so we’re working hard to get this update to you as soon as possible! As an aside, thank you for your patience with us, I personally am very glad to be devoting my energies to this game again with full force.

Signed, Aristophanes Yates

notes.title: A delay
notes.content:
Sadly real life happens. my partner in game dev has had real life sneak up on him and the game will be delayed. We will continue to make the game to the best of our ability. And we will be continuing the development of the game, as we have an update to the demo in the works and is ALMOST ready. We thank you for playing the game, and the patience in this time.

A little bit about us. We are a small team of two, we both have other responsibilities. As we are still doing this in our part time. I have no background in game dev and I am figuring this out as we go along. I am self taught, and only started about two years ago. While my partner in this, has a formal background in this. Neither of us are writers, or artists but we are doing the best we can. We are grateful for the support, and you taking time to play our games.

Signed, Pirate Dave

notes.title: the demo is live! (feed back here)
notes.content:
We would like to welcome everyone who is playing our demo, we look forward to your feed back. although the game is still in the early days we have been working hard to bring you the best game we can. the demo as it is, is meant to act as an "early alpha" of sorts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508875/51a42dcc9dc641d5cddd659a02cf32283da44068.png[/img]

[b]in the demo,[/b]
-you can explore two hand crafted levels
-discover a few hidden outfits
-unlock an additional character
-test out our gadgets 

The best place to get your voice heard is the subreddit. 
/r/BodaciousAgents
or in the discussion below this post



We are a small team of two, and are vary new to this game dev thing, but look forward to the bright future games we can make. Although this game is very early we are making strides towards the game we want to make.

[b]Future planes/the game we want to make[/b]
-at least 5 unique levels
-4 playable characters
-every character will have many unique outfits
-interesting tools to aid in the completion of you mission
